title: People and their work
summary: The person who does the job, not the job itself.

questions.clue: This person designs buildings and draws the plans that builders work from.
questions.note: The ch is pronounced like a k. The person who does the actual construction is a builder or a contractor.

questions.clue: You call this person when a pipe bursts or a tap will not stop dripping.
questions.note: The b is silent. It comes from the Latin for lead, because water pipes were once made of it.

questions.clue: This scientist studies the atmosphere and forecasts what the weather will do.
questions.note: Nothing to do with meteors. The word comes from a Greek term for things high in the air.

questions.clue: This person digs up and studies the physical remains of ancient human life.
questions.note: Both spellings are correct, the shorter one being American. A palaeontologist studies fossils of animals rather than human remains.

questions.clue: This person turns written text from one language into another.
questions.note: A translator works with writing and has time to think. Somebody converting speech as it happens is an interpreter, which is why that word is not accepted here.

questions.clue: This is the doctor who treats animals rather than people.
questions.note: Vet is the everyday word and is accepted, along with the full forms used on a sign or a certificate.

questions.clue: This person makes and repairs things out of wood.
questions.note: A joiner traditionally makes the finer fitted work such as doors and staircases, but the two words overlap in ordinary use.

questions.clue: This person gathers information and writes reports for newspapers or broadcasters.
questions.note: A reporter gathers the news, a correspondent usually covers one region or subject, and journalist covers both.

questions.clue: This person keeps and checks the financial records of a person or a company.
questions.note: An accountant prepares and interprets the accounts. A bookkeeper records the day to day transactions that an accountant then works from.

questions.clue: This person is learning a skilled trade by working alongside somebody who already has it.
questions.note: An apprenticeship is a formal arrangement with an agreed length, which is what distinguishes it from simply being new.
